text:
maria_cs: Heads-up — prepping QBR for Northfork (renewal ~45d). We saw a 3x spend spike last 7d from an embeddings backfill. Need to align on token cushion + budget alert strategy. cc @tyler_cs_ops @dave_finops

tyler_cs_ops: On it. Do we have a quick projection? I can run a 30d forecast and produce two scenarios (steady vs spike).

dave_finops: Need raw usage by route to show finance. Recommend we present: (A) on-demand + alerting + throttles, or (B) 6mo reserved commit with cushion. Suggest proposing a 25% buffer and an alert at 70% of monthly commit.

maria_cs: Pulled last 14 days. Avg tokens/day (excluding 3-day spike) ~12M. If sustained that's ~360M/mo. Spike days were ~60M/day for 3 days due to re-ingest. Snippet below:
```
route, avg_tokens/day
chat, 3_200_000
embed, 7_400_000
vector-indexing, 1_400_000
```

alerts-bot: :rotating_light: Budget alert created: Northfork-Prod hitting 50% of monthly threshold. https://console.redwood.ai/accounts/northfork/alerts/9876

tyler_cs_ops: Two presentation options for QBR slide: 
1) On-demand w/ alerts + optional auto-throttle for ingest jobs (no commit; higher unit costs)
2) 6mo reserved capacity with commit (approx ~18% unit cost savings given current profile). I'll put numbers next to each.

dave_finops: Looks reasonable. Please add scenario for a sustained re-ingest (x2 baseline) to show worst-case commit need. Also include projected $ impact and suggested commit band (e.g., $30k/mo -> $37.5k/mo with 25% cushion).

maria_cs: Action items: @tyler_cs_ops prepare slide w/ 2 scenarios + worst-case re-ingest by EOD. @dave_finops draft commit pricing + savings calc. I'll run a prompt-level sampling to flag top token consumers and request permission to show per-route details in the QBR. Also scheduling enablement call with Northfork eng for next Tue.

tyler_cs_ops: :thumbsup: Quick ask — can we route budget alerts to #northfork-ops channel? They prefer direct ops notifications instead of emails.

dave_finops: Agreed. Also recommend we propose a short-term pre-authorized credits top-up to avoid hard throttles during onboarding/backfills. That keeps UX intact and reduces churn risk.

maria_cs: Good call. I'll include a one-slide "safety net" recommendation: pre-auth credits + throttle policy + alerting thresholds. No objections?

tyler_cs_ops: None here. I'll include example alert thresholds + sample alert message.

dave_finops: No objections. Reminder: flag renewal risk if monthly avg > commit - 10% for two consecutive months.

maria_cs: Thanks — will draft QBR notes and share deck link when ready. I'll also DM Northfork to request consent to include route-level usage in the QBR.

(reacts: maria_cs :white_check_mark:, tyler_cs_ops :thumbsup: )
